curated.category: 心血管机械性梗阻急危重症
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 包裹心脏的坚韧“心包膜”腔隙内短时间涌入大量液体或血液（如肿瘤、感染渗出、心脏手术或冠脉穿孔出血、主动脉夹层破入心包），把心脏死死勒住，使心室无法舒张吸血; 2) 典型表现为“Beck三联征”（低血压、颈静脉怒张、心音低钝遥远）及奇脉，若不立即穿刺放液减压，数分钟至数小时内即发生梗阻性休克与电机械分离猝死。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 绝大多数非主动脉夹层/心脏破裂所致的心包压塞，只要在床旁超声引导下紧急行心包穿刺引流（放出哪怕仅50–100ml积液），心脏压迫立即解除、血压瞬间回升，属立竿见影的救命操作；后续需针对病因（如抗结核、抗肿瘤或抗炎）根治。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO GHE未单独统计心包压塞死亡数，通常归入原发病（恶性肿瘤心包转移、急性主动脉夹层或结核性心包炎）；若未及时穿刺减压病死率接近100%

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国尚无全国独立登记；国内以恶性肿瘤心包转移、尿毒症、结核及介入手术并发症为主因，及时超声引导穿刺成功率>95%
annual_deaths_china.source: 中华医学会心血管病学分会心包疾病共识

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 住院心包积液患者中约 15%–20% 可进展为心包压塞，恶性心包积液与急性主动脉夹层最常见（ESC）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 属心内科与急诊科常见致命急症，在肿瘤合并心包积液及心血管介入中心尤为常见

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 患者突发极度呼吸困难（端坐呼吸）、面色发绀、颈部血管明显怒张、血压骤降，立即拨打120送往有超声心动图及心包穿刺条件的医院急诊; 2) 急救核心：立即行床旁超声引导下心包穿刺置管引流术（POCUS-guided pericardiocentesis），切忌在确诊压塞后给患者强行使用大剂量利尿剂或扩血管药（会瞬间抽干心脏充盈压导致骤停）; 3) 唯一例外：若超声或CT提示为主动脉夹层破入心包或心室壁破裂导致的血性心包压塞，原则上禁忌常规大量穿刺减压（以免血压骤升诱发致命性二次大出血），需立即开胸行外科修补手术。

standard_drugs.name_zh: 氯化钠注射液 / 平衡盐溶液
standard_drugs.drug_class: 静脉晶体扩容液体（穿刺前短时维持右心室充盈压的过渡支持）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 穿刺引流前的紧急临时过渡扩容
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国内公立医院参考价约3–8元/袋（500ml）

standard_drugs.drug_class: 微管聚合抑制剂（抑制NLRP3炎症小体，降低炎症性心包积液复发）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 特发性/炎症性心包压塞引流后预防再发积液
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国内公立医院参考价约15–35元/盒，3个月疗程约60–150元
standard_drugs.cost_source: 中国公立医院药品挂网公开参考价

non_drug_therapies_zh: 急诊超声引导下心包穿刺置管引流术（首选剑突下或心尖部入路，留置猪尾导管持续引流至24小时引流量<30ml）
外科心包开窗术（Pericardial window）用于恶性肿瘤反复复发的心包积液
胸腔镜或开胸紧急心包修补术（专门针对主动脉夹层或心肌梗死心脏破裂所致血性压塞）
明确并根治原发病（如恶性肿瘤靶向/化疗、抗结核规范治疗、充分血液透析）
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 急诊床旁超声引导心包穿刺引流及住院检查总费用约8,000–25,000元人民币；若因心脏破裂或主动脉夹层需急诊开胸手术，住院总费用可达10万–25万元

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023–2024年急性心包压塞救治强调床旁即时超声（POCUS）标准化流程普及，显著降低了盲穿导致的心肌穿孔或气胸并发症（并发症率降至<1%）；对于反复复发的特发性或自身炎症性心包积液，IL-1抑制剂（如Rilonacept、Anakinra）在RHAPSODY等3期研究后已成为激素依赖性患者预防心包压塞复发的强力靶向武器。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 恶性心包积液引流后复发率仍高达40%–70%，亟需安全有效的局部心包腔内长效抗肿瘤/硬化剂; 2) 基层急诊缺乏全天候床旁超声引导穿刺培训，易因误诊为普通心衰而误用利尿剂致死; 3) 亚急性隐匿性心包积液缺乏无创早期压力预警。

master.definition_en: Empty sella syndrome (ESS) is a condition that involves the sella turcica, a bony structure at the base of the brain that protects the pituitary gland. There is a primary and secondary form of the condition. The primary form occurs when a structural defect above the pituitary gland increases pressure in the sella turcica and causes the gland to flatten. The secondary form occurs when the pituitary gland is damaged due to injury, a tumor, surgery or radiation therapy. Some people with ESS have no symptoms. People with secondary ESS may have symptoms of decreased pituitary function such as absence of menstruation, infertility, fatigue, and intolerance to stress and infection. In children, ESS may be associated with early onset of puberty, growth hormone deficiency, pituitary tumors, or pituitary gland dysfunction. Treatment focuses on the symptoms present in each person.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑

master.definition_en: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) is a group of diseases characterized by mean pulmonary artery pressure >20 mmHg and elevated pulmonary arterial resistance leading to right heart failure. PAH is progressive and potentially fatal. PAH may be idiopathic and/ or familial, have overt features of venous/capillary involvement (pulmonary veno-occlusive disease, PVOD/pulmonary capillary hemangiomatosis, PCH), induced by drug or toxin (drug-or toxin-induced PAH), or associated with other diseases like congenital heart disease, connective tissue disease, HIV, schistosomiasis, portal hypertension (PAH associated with other disease).

aliases_zh: 特发性/遗传性肺动脉高压
curated.category: 慢性心血管与血管疾病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 被称为‘心血管界的癌症’：肺小动脉持续重构管腔狭窄，导致肺动脉压与右心后负荷进行性飙升，终致难治性右心衰竭与低心排猝死；在无靶向药时代中位生存期仅约2.8年，中国前靶向时代1年/3年生存率仅68%和39%；经规范双/三联靶向治疗及激活素抑制剂后，现代中国PAH注册队列1/3/5年生存率已跃升至约92%–95.4% / 75%–84.3% / 72.3%–79.2%；剧烈运动、妊娠或急性肺部感染可诱发数小时内致死的‘肺动脉高压危象’。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 尚不能药物根治，但内皮素受体拮抗剂+PDE5抑制剂/sGC激动剂+前列环素通路三联靶向药已全部纳入中国国家常规临床药品目录（大幅降低费用），且2026年全球首创反向重塑新药索他西普（Sotatercept）已在华获批并迅速纳入新版常规药品保障目录，显著逆转肺血管病变进展。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: GBD 2021首次将PAH（WHO第1大类）单列死因，估算全球年死亡约22,000例（95% UI 18,200–25,400，ASMR 0.27/10万人，Flinders / Lancet Respir Med 2024）

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无全国全人群官方单列死亡总数；GBD 2021中国研究（Frontiers in Medicine 2025 PMC11748298）显示中国PAH标化死亡率呈年均-1.26%持续下降，中国现代多中心PAH队列1/3/5年生存率分别达92%–95.4% / 75%–84.3% / 72.3%–79.2%（PubMed PMID:41299390）
annual_deaths_china.source: Frontiers in Medicine PMC11748298 / China PAH Registry PMID:41299390

epidemiology.prevalence_global: GBD 2021估算全球PAH现患病例约 19.2 万例（95% UI 15.5万–23.6万，ASPR 2.28/10万人，女性占约62%）；Orphanet ORPHA:182090 欧洲点患病率约 1–9 / 10万人（约1.5–5.2/10万）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: Orphanet收录中国特发性/遗传性PAH（ORPHA:422）点患病率约 6.25 / 10万人（PMID:34103049）；中国PAH人群中先天性心脏病相关PAH（CHD-PAH）占比显著高于欧美（PMC11748298），且1990–2021年绝对患病人数因老龄化及诊疗提升增长约86.74%

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 肺动脉高压危象急救：立即予吸氧维持血氧饱和度>90%（避免高碳酸血症与酸中毒进一步收缩肺血管），严禁快速大量补液以防右室急性过扩张压迫左室；谨慎使用去甲肾上腺素/血管加压素维持体循环灌注压保障右冠脉血供，联合吸入一氧化氮（iNO）或吸入伊洛前列素/静脉曲前列尼尔紧急降肺动脉压，必要时VA-ECMO过渡至靶向强化或肺移植。

master.definition_en: Fibrochondrogenesis is a rare, neonatally lethal, rhizomelic chondrodysplasia. Eleven cases have been reported. The face is distinctive and characterized by protuberant eyes, flat midface, flat small nose with anteverted nares and a small mouth with long upper lip. Cleft palate, micrognathia and bifid tongue can occur. The limbs show marked shortness of all segments with relatively normal hands and feet. No internal anomalies other than omphalocele have been reported. Transmission is probably autosomal recessive. Recurrence in a consanguineous family (affecting both sexes) and concordance of affected male twins have been reported.

master.definition_en: A rare, idiopathic skin disease characterized by widespread, congenital, superficial erosions and vesicles (often involving more than 75% of the body) which heal leaving scars with a supple, symmetrical, reticulated pattern, frequently resulting in cicatricial alopecia and hyperthermia and/or hypohydrosis. Nail anomalies, neurodevelopmental and ophtalmologic abnormalities, tongue atrophy and preterm birth, with or without history of choriomnionitis, are commonly associated.
synonyms_en: congenital erosive and vesicular dermatosis with reticulated supple scarring

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。

master.definition_en: A developmental glaucoma that results from the abnormal development of the aqueous drainage structure, characterized by an elevated intra-ocular pressure, enlargement of globe (buphthalmos), corneal edema and optic nerve cupping, and presenting clinically with the characteristic triad of epiphora, photophobia and blepharospasm.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: A rare venous malformation characterized by splenic non-encapsulated, non-neoplastic vascular channels of varying sizes (ranging from capillaries to cavernous vessels) containing slow-flowing blood. The majority of patients are asymptomatic and the condition is usually discovered incidentally. When patients are symptomatic, they may present with dyspnea, abdominal pain, splenomegaly, diarrhea, or constipation. Lesions are usually benign with no malignant potential. However, very large lesions may require splenectomy due to their increased risk of rupture, which may lead to intra-abdominal hemorrhage.

master.definition_en: A genetically heterogeneous cardiac disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the TNNT2 gene and inherited in an autosomal dominant manner. Affected individuals present with a spectrum of cardiomyopathy phenotypes, including dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), restrictive cardiomyopathy (RCM), and left ventricular noncompaction (LVNC). Clinical features may include heart failure, ventricular arrhythmias, and sudden cardiac death. Overlapping or mixed cardiomyopathy phenotypes, as well as variable expressivity within families, have also been reported.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。
